mil3.1.4:1.2: paṇḍito kho ayaṃ bhikkhu, paṭibalo mayā saddhiṃ sallapituṃ, bahukāni ca me ṭhānāni pucchitabbāni bhavissanti, yāva apucchitāni yeva tāni ṭhānāni bhavissanti atha suriyo atthaṃ gamissati, yan-nūnāhaṃ sve antepure sallapeyyan-ti.
mil3.1.4:2.2: Tena hi tvaṃ Devamantiya bhadantassa āroceyyāsi: sve antepure raññā saddhiṃ sallāpo bhavissatīti.
mil3.1.4:2.3: Idaṃ vatvā Milindo rājā uṭṭhāy' āsanā theraṃ Nāgasenaṃ āpucchitvā assaṃ abhirūhitvā Nāgaseno Nāgaseno ti sajjhāyaṃ karonto pakkāmi.
mil3.1.4:3.1: Atha kho Devamantiyo āyasmantaṃ Nāgasenaṃ etad-avoca:
mil3.1.4:3.5: Atha kho tassā rattiyā accayena Devamantiyo ca Anantakāyo ca Mankuro ca Sabbadinno ca yena Milindo rājā ten' upasankamiṃsu, upasankamitvā rājānaṃ Milindaṃ etad-avocuṃ:
mil3.1.4:3.9: Yattake bhikkhū icchati tattakehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ āgacchatūti.-
mil3.1.4:4.4: Yattake bhikkhū icchati tattakehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ āgacchatūti.
mil3.1.4:4.8: Yattake bhikkhū icchati tattakehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ āgacchatūti.
mil3.1.4:4.11: Sabbo panāyaṃ sakkāro paṭiyādito, ahaṃ bhaṇāmi: yattake bhikkhū icchati tattakehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ āgacchatūti,
mil3.1.4:4.12: ayaṃ bhaṇe Sabbadinno aññathā bhaṇati, kin-nu mayaṃ na paṭibalā bhikkhūnaṃ bhojanaṃ dātun-ti.-
mil3.1.4:5.1: Atha kho Devamantiyo ca Anantakāyo ca Mankuro ca yen' āyasmā Nāgaseno ten' upasankamiṃsu, upasankamitvā āyasmantaṃ Nāgasenaṃ etad-avocum:
mil3.1.4:5.3: yattake bhikkhū icchati tattakehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ āgacchatūti.
mil3.1.4:5.4: Atha kho āyasmā Nāgaseno pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram-ādāya asītiyā bhikkhusahassehi saddhiṃ Sāgalaṃ pāvisi.
mil3.1.4:6.1: Atha kho Anantakāyo āyasmantaṃ Nāgasenaṃ nissāya gacchanto āyasmantaṃ Nāgasenaṃ etad-avoca:
mil3.1.4:6.2: Bhante Nāgasena, yaṃ pan' etaṃ brūmi Nāgaseno ti katam' ettha Nāgaseno ti.
mil3.1.4:6.4: Ko pan' ettha Nāgaseno ti maññasīti.-
mil3.1.4:6.5: Yo so bhante abbhantare-vāyo jīvo pavisati ca nikkhamati ca so Nāgaseno ti maññāmīti.-
mil3.1.4:6.6: Yadi pan' eso vāto nikkhamitvā na paviseyya pavisitvā na nikkhameyya jīveyya nu kho so puriso ti.-
mil3.1.4:6.8: Ye pan' ime sankhadhamakā sankhaṃ dhamenti tesaṃ vāto puna pavisatīti.-
mil3.1.4:6.10: Ye pan' ime vaṃsadhamakā vaṃsaṃ dhamenti tesaṃ vāto puna pavisatīti.-
mil3.1.4:6.12: Ye pan' ime singadhamakā singaṃ dhamenti tesaṃ vāto puna pavisatīti.-
mil3.1.4:6.14: Atha kissa pana te na marantīti.-
mil3.1.4:6.15: Nāhaṃ paṭibalo tayā vādinā saddhiṃ sallapituṃ, sādhu bhante, atthaṃ jappehīti.-
mil3.1.4:6.16: N' eso jīvo, assāsa-passāsā nām' ete kāyasankhārā ti thero Abhidhammakathaṃ akāsi.
